APPLICATION PLANNING

Recommended Uses

22 oz stadium cup

Tailgate & Car Parties ↗

A 22 oz PP wide-mouth stadium cup: Stacks a full case in the boot for a twenty-person meet.

Backyard BBQ ↗

Grabbed off the table at random, carried off in one stack.

Beach Parties ↗

Empties nest together for the walk back to the car.

Confirm for your project

Check venue container rules, pour size and how it travels in the car；table layout, how many rounds it serves and washing conditions；the venue's no-glass rule, wind and sand exposure, and how it gets washed.

These are selection suggestions. Review the chosen configuration and sample against your intended use.
